messages.subject: Project Drake — funds flow & completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark, Richard,

Ahead of completion on 20 February, attached are (1) the completion funds flow and (2) the draft completion statement. Headlines: £36.5m initial cash to the sellers' solicitors, £3m to escrow, £1.8m to redeem the Clydesford debt; the working-capital adjustment is currently a £0.36m payment to the sellers (actual WC £4.56m vs £4.2m target), subject to the post-completion accounts.

Treasury should action the payment instructions on the morning of completion.

James
